operations.details: Verified HMLR Title Number and UPRN technical specification.
Title number and UPRN kept as separate identifiers with conditional association.
Missing UPRN not interpreted as missing registered title or parcel.
Multi-property titles allowed to map to multiple UPRNs without forced one-to-one join.
Verified HMLR Title Descriptor technical specification.
Pending-registration title numbers separated from completed estate/class attributes.
Class-of-title treated as legal registration status only.
Identity and class fields rejected as geometry or elevation substitutes.
No identifier gap or status field converted into inferred parcel measurements.
Canonical manifest unchanged; serial publisher still required.
